Question:
Are independent directors at least one-third
of the total number of Board members?

Does the Board have policies and procedures
to annually assess the independence of
independent Board members?

Do all independent Board members have a
tenure of less than 9 years?

Is the Board comprised of a majority of
non-executive board members?

Does the Board ensure a smooth transition
of Board members?

Has the Board established an Audit
Committee according to Code
requirements?

Are the functions of the Chairperson and the
Chief Executive Officer exercised by different
individuals?

Is the Chairman of the Board a non-executive
board member?

Has the Board established procedures to
allow its members access to relevant,
accurate and complete information and
professional advice?

Has the Board adopted a policy on managing
conflict of interest?

Has the Board adopted a policy on related
party transactions which meets the
requirements of the Code?
